title: Mega AI (gomega.ai) Review 2026: Features, Pricing, Reviews
summary: Mega AI (gomega.ai) review for 2026: its four agents, the Conversion agent that answers leads, why there is no price list, and paid ads only on the top plan.
body_markdown:
## The short answer


- **Mega AI is a real, well-funded company** selling four AI agents to small businesses: SEO and AI search, paid ads, website and lead conversion.
- Its strongest piece is the Conversion agent, which answers calls, texts and DMs and books leads. Few marketing tools do that.
- It publishes no prices. Every plan is sold on a sales call, and paid ads are only in the top plan, Grow Faster.
- Paid ads run on Google and Meta. If you also advertise on LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft or Reddit, you will need something else for those.


Plans, agents and company facts as listed on gomega.ai on November 21, 2026.


## What Mega AI is


Mega AI, at gomega.ai, calls itself a set of AI agents that run your SEO, ads and website and help you turn leads into revenue. The pitch is a whole growth team for a small business at a fraction of an agency retainer. It sells mainly to local and service businesses: its industry pages cover healthcare, home services, legal, real estate, financial services and beauty.


The company is Mega AI, Inc. Its company page names co-founders Lucas Pellan and Robert Schneidman and investors including a16z, Valor Equity Partners and SignalFire, and its press page links coverage of an $11.5M raise. One naming trap: Mega AI is not MEGA, the cloud storage service, so a search for "mega login" mixes the two.


## The four agents


- **SEO and GEO.** Researches keywords and competitors, writes and publishes content, fixes technical issues and works on visibility in Google and AI answers such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.
- **Paid Ads.** Builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across Google and Meta, with creative and weekly reporting.
- **Website.** Audits your current site, then designs and builds pages or a full site into Webflow, Framer, WordPress or Shopify.
- **Conversion.** Answers inquiries across calls, your site, SMS, email and DMs, qualifies them and books the right leads onto your calendar.


## What Mega AI does well


### Lead response


For a plumber, a law firm or a clinic, the lead that goes to voicemail is the most expensive leak in the business. Mega's Conversion agent answers it, asks the qualifying questions and books the job. That is a real job most ad and SEO tools leave alone, Sprites included.


### One package for a local business


A business with no website, no SEO and no one to answer the phone gets all of it from one vendor, set up for them after a call. For an owner who wants it done rather than chosen, that is the appeal.


## Where Mega AI stops


### No published price


The pricing page lists Starter, Grow and Grow Faster and a "Schedule a call" button on each. You cannot compare it with another tool, or know whether it fits your budget, without a sales conversation first.


### Paid ads only on the top plan


Starter is the Website and SEO and GEO agents; Grow adds Conversion. The Paid Ads agent arrives only with Grow Faster, the plan with all four. If ads are your main channel, you are buying the most expensive package to get them.


### Two ad platforms


Mega's paid ads page names Google and Meta. A B2B company on LinkedIn, an app on TikTok, or anyone buying Microsoft or Reddit ads will run those somewhere else.


### Check the reviews before you sign


Mega has a public Trustpilot page. Read the recent reviews, including the low ones, and ask on the call what is delivered in the first 30 days and how cancellation and refunds work, before you commit to a plan.

## Who should use Mega AI


A local service business whose leads arrive by phone and get lost, that needs a new website, and that would rather buy a package on a call than set up tools. Who should look elsewhere: a business whose customers come from paid ads and search, one that advertises beyond Google and Meta, or anyone who wants to see the price before talking to sales. For them,[an AI agent for SEO, ads and website](https://www.sprites.ai/best/ai-agent-for-seo-ads-and-website) on a published price is the better fit.


## Mega AI review questions


### Is Mega AI legit?


Yes. Mega AI is the product of Mega AI, Inc. at gomega.ai. Its company page names its co-founders, Lucas Pellan and Robert Schneidman, and investors including a16z, Valor Equity Partners and SignalFire, and its homepage says it serves more than 1,000 small and medium-sized businesses. It is not the file-hosting service MEGA, a different company.


### What does Mega AI do?


Mega AI sells four AI agents to small businesses: SEO and GEO for Google and AI search, Paid Ads for Google and Meta campaigns, Website for building and improving your site, and Conversion, which answers calls, texts, email and DMs, qualifies leads and books them onto your calendar.


### How much does Mega AI cost?


Mega AI does not publish prices. Its pricing page lists three plans, Starter, Grow and Grow Faster, and each one says "Schedule a call". See our[Mega AI pricing](https://www.sprites.ai/blog/gomega-ai-pricing) breakdown for what each plan includes.


### Does Mega AI run paid ads on every plan?


No. The Paid Ads agent is only in Grow Faster, the plan with all four agents. Starter covers the website and SEO, and Grow adds lead conversion.


### Which ad platforms does Mega AI support?


Its paid ads page says the agent builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across Google and Meta. LinkedIn, Microsoft, TikTok and Reddit are not listed as ad channels.


### What is a good alternative to Mega AI?


It depends on the job. For ads and search on a published price, Sprites: Build is $29 to $99 a month with paid ads, SEO and AI visibility in one plan, on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft and Reddit. Ryze AI is a cheaper ads agent that sells SEO as a separate plan. GoHighLevel suits a business that mainly wants a CRM with SMS and booking.
